readerCopy.body: Anger can appear at the exact place where assertion once came with embarrassment, punishment, or pressure to take up less space. When Mars conjoins Chiron, action and sensitivity fuse, making a clear no or forceful response arrive alongside the reflex to soften it immediately. Frustration can also build until a small request carries the force of a much older lesson about what was allowed. The anger becomes useful when it identifies the boundary without requiring the boundary to disappear just because stating it feels uncomfortable.
